known_traps: provider/seams.py is async; envelope/pass0.py and pass1.py protocols are sync. No bridge exists. Returns a coroutine, rejects all chapters, empty plan, NO exception. docs/25 2.
Envelope.stripped() removes the skeleton as well as findings - cannot separate the two without a fourth variant.
join_in_plan_order raises IncompleteArtefactError on empty spans. Never catch it.
No seed parameter exists anywhere. CAMPAIGN_SEEDS are run identifiers; variance comes from repeats.

compile_plan.py: duplicate concept ids ACROSS chapters make _topological_order raise UnsequenceablePlanError with an EMPTY implicated list. Not a real cycle. Fix by merging on id, never by rejecting the second declaration. docs/28 §3.

Tier 2 on a reasoning model can spend its whole output budget on reasoning tokens and return empty (output_tokens == cap exactly). Truncation BELOW the cap is invisible to the empty check. docs/28 §2.

verified_since_last_update: docs/24 4's 'one check outstanding' - the detector's 41 and missing_outline's 41 are the SAME signal, not independent measurements: every one of the 41 zero-source calls is the last trajectory entry for its concept (0 superseded), which is exactly the shape missing_outline's un-revisited fill-in batch produces. eval/groundedness.py module docstring; tests/test_groundedness.py::test_ungrounded_count_is_exactly_the_missing_outline_batch.

findings.architectural_variability: Three identical-prompt repeats produced three different self-authored architectures: seed 11 = 8 root iterations / 14 sub-calls, chapter granularity; seed 23 = 11 / 29 plus a whole-document edit pass; seed 42 = 17 / 151, per-concept granularity. A 10x spread in sub-call count. 156/190/75 is not dispersion around a mean; averaging is a category error. docs/32 §4.
findings.join_guard_earned_its_place: IncompleteArtefactError caught 15 empty Tier 2 builders on the first real MARD run. docs/28 §2.
findings.baseline_grounded_at_one_remove: Seeds 11 and 23 have NO per-concept generating call - the root wrote every explanation itself. Their background sub-calls are 14/14 and 29/29 grounded, so those runs are grounded at one remove, not ungrounded. Only seed 42 delegated per concept, and 41/75 of those were source-less. docs/32 §2.
